name: minutes-round-up-into-next-degree
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.10 (the text wire), dm encode: m = round(|x|*60*1e5); lat 48.99999998333333*60*1e5 = 293999999.90000004 -> m = 294000000 = 49*6000000 + 0, so 4900.00000; lon 11.999999918333334*60*1e5 = 71999999.50999999 -> m = 72000000 = 12*6000000, so 01200.00000. The carry goes into the degrees. Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program (Python standard library).
